note: Adapted from the English redescription of Scheffrahn & Křeček 1999; the original description is Bacchus 1987, which was not obtained for this batch (no open-access version), so the morphology and measurements given here are all from Scheffrahn & Křeček 1999, the measurements covering only 1 female and 1 male dealate and 2 soldiers, a very small sample. The original notes that the species is closest to C. spathifrons, differing in the two planes formed by the foramen magnum surface and the frontal face in lateral view: in this species they diverge posteriorly, whereas in C. spathifrons they are parallel. The species is rare, known only from the south coast of Jamaica near the type locality.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Body pale yellow, darkest on the head and the wing scales; the central chevron on the forewing scale rusty orange. Pronotum and abdominal tergites and sternites pale yellow. Antennae orange-yellow. Labrum pale orange. Femora of the legs yellowish white, the ends orange-yellow. Cranial sutures absent. Compound eyes medium-sized, nearly circular, the edge opposite the antennal socket straight; posteroventral margin almost straight. Ocelli medium-sized, oval along the transverse axis, almost touching the compound eyes. In the specimens examined the tips of the antennae are broken, the segment formula 2<3>4=5. Pronotum as wide as or slightly wider than the head including the compound eyes, wider than long; anterior margin moderately concave, the sides moderately convex, the posterior margin incised in the middle and biconvex at the sides. Arolium present.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Measurements (1 female and 1 male, 1 colony, dealates, in mm): head length including the labrum 1.42—1.47 (1.45±0.035); head length to the postclypeus 1.13—1.16 (1.14±0.023); maximum head width across the compound eyes 1.16—1.19 (1.18±0.023); compound eye diameter 0.37—0.38 (0.38±0.012); shortest distance from the compound eye to the posterior margin of the head 0.12—0.14 (0.13±0.012); ocellus diameter 0.12—0.13 (0.13±0.0058); maximum pronotal length 0.85—0.87 (0.86±0.012); maximum pronotal width 1.19 (1.19±0); total body length without wings 5.75—5.96 (5.86±0.15).

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head, in dorsal view, with the frontal margin, frontal horns and genal horns almost black; the anterior half of the frontal face very dark chestnut brown, the posterior half chestnut brown; vertex rusty orange, only the anterior corners very dark chestnut brown and the posterior margin orange-yellow. Head, in lateral view, rusty orange, slightly paler posteriorly. Mandibles dark chestnut brown. Anterior margin of the pronotum rusty, the remaining margins rusty orange, the interior pale yellow. Head, in dorsal view, with the frontal face distinctly sunken and invading the vertex, occupying one third of the head capsule length. Head, in dorsal view, slightly constricted in front of the compound eyes, the compound eyes slightly protruding and the head capsule behind them slightly bulbous. Vertex not concave. Head capsule only moderately rugose on the frontal face and on the narrow band behind the frontal margin, otherwise almost smooth. Frontal margin semicircular in outline, callose, unusually narrow and raised above the frontal face; the base of the frontal margin slightly concave on each side. Frontal face broad, even, shallowly concave. Frontal face meeting the vertex face at 50°. Labrum large, ligulate, pointed at the apex, slightly swollen at the tip and with lateral depressions. Frontal horns short, thick and rounded, spreading at the base; continuous with the frontal margin but clearly delimited from the frontal face, with a deep depression between them and the clypeus; the axes of the two frontal horns nearly parallel. Genal horns short finger-like projections extending forward from the genae, their axes spreading at 90°. Frontal horns and genal horns far apart, the volume of the former about twice that of the latter. Mandibles long, with a distinct swelling at the base; teeth blunt. Compound eyes small, oval. Antennae 11—12-segmented, the segment formula 2<3>4=5. Pronotum almost circular, with only a deep, broad incision on the anterior margin and a short, straight posterior margin. Anterior margin of the pronotum densely covered with blunt undulations.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Measurements (2 individuals, 2 colonies, in mm): head length to the tip of the mandibles 2.04—2.31 (2.18±0.19); head length to the frontal horns 1.65—1.68 (1.66±0.023); frontal margin width 1.19—1.26 (1.23±0.046); outer span of the frontal horns 1.00—1.06 (1.03±0.046); maximum head width 1.39—1.46 (1.42±0.046); head height without the postmentum 1.06—1.14 (1.10±0.058); maximum pronotal width 1.31—1.32 (1.32±0.012); maximum pronotal length 0.95—0.98 (0.96±0.023); left mandible length (apex to ventral articulation) 1.00—1.01 (1.01±0.012); total body length 3.76—4.95 (4.36±0.84).
